title: Mourners in Gaza Bury Remains of Loved Ones Killed in 2023 Israeli Airstrike
detail: Mourners in Gaza gathered to bury the remains of loved ones killed in a 2023 Israeli airstrike, underscoring the prolonged human toll of the war's earlier phases. The burials highlight how families continue to recover and identify victims years after strikes, as the ongoing ceasefire violations leave communities grappling with both fresh casualties and unresolved losses from earlier fighting.
